q: Pernyataan dasar OSH menjadi titik permulaan untuk:
e: Why OSH policy is important: the starting point for planning and organising OSH programmes; juga panduan bagi semua peringkat pekerja.

q: Dasar OSH berfungsi sebagai panduan kepada:
c: Semua peringkat pekerja dalam membuat tindakan dan keputusan
e: A guide for all levels of employees to base their actions and decisions.

q: Menurut keperluan statutori OSHA 1994, pekerja mesti:
e: Statutory requirement: written OSH policy; employees must be aware of the requirements of the policy; implemented; revised when necessary.

q: Dalam keperluan dasar OSH, elemen 'Arrangements' merujuk kepada:
c: Pelan, sumber, prosedur dan sistem kerja
e: Organisation = responsibilities; Arrangements = plans, resources, procedures, system of work, etc.

q: Bagaimanakah dasar OSH perlu dikomunikasikan kepada pekerja?
c: Mengumumkan dan mempamerkan pernyataan, serta menyampaikan tanggungjawab dan program OSH
e: Langkah 3 – Communicate the policy: announce and display statement, communicate responsibilities and OSH programmes.

q: Dalam akronim SMART, 'Measurable' bermaksud:
e: SMART: Simple (bahasa mudah), Measurable (performance can be monitored), Achievable (realistic), Reasonable (aim high but practical), Tractable (dapat dijejak).

q: Dalam SMART, 'Reasonable' bermaksud dasar perlu:
e: Reasonable: always aim high but must be practical.

q: Pernyataan 'Responsible Care' dalam dasar OSH merujuk kepada pertimbangan terhadap:
e: Make statements that take into account: vision and goals (zero accident), legislation, clients, associations ('Responsible Care') dan keperluan Seksyen 16 OSHA.

q: Komitmen untuk mematuhi prosedur keselamatan pelanggan dalam dasar OSH mengambil kira:
e: Clients: compliance to clients' safety procedures.

q: Contoh yang diberi bagi sifat bahaya yang berubah-ubah dan perlu ditangani dalam dasar OSH ialah:
e: Address nature of hazards: e.g. changing nature of hazards in various phase of construction industry.

q: Menurut contoh peranan dalam dasar OSH, tugas menyelia kontraktor diberikan kepada:
e: Contoh: managers & supervisors enforce OSH rules; employee report near-misses; supervisors investigate accidents; managers supervise contractors.

q: Yang manakah contoh program OSH dalam pelaksanaan dasar?
c: Penyelenggaraan peralatan dan loji kritikal keselamatan
e: Example of programme: maintenance of safety critical equipment and plant, safe working environment, means of access/egress, Job Safety Analysis.

q: Langkah pelaksanaan dasar selepas menetapkan program OSH ialah:
e: Implementing: 1 goals/objectives/risks, 2 establish OSH programmes, 3 provide resources and assign responsibilities.

q: Penubuhan Jawatankuasa Keselamatan dan pelantikan SHO dipantau dalam rekod kategori:
e: Monitoring – record keeping: accident/ill health record, compliance with legislation, appointments (SHO, Safety Committee), targets, compliance with arrangements.

q: Siasatan insiden dan kemalangan ialah salah satu kaedah:
e: Monitoring the OSH policy: monitoring & surveillance, workplace inspections, auditing, incident/accident investigation.

q: Perubahan perniagaan dan pengubahsuaian loji atau proses menuntut:
e: Reviewing and revising (by Safety Committee): operational/organisational changes, alterations of plant or processes, new legislation, new hazards, change of business.

q: Dalam Latihan 1, bahaya ketara di ABC Chemicals TIDAK termasuk:
w: Sentuhan dengan bahan kimia berbahaya kepada kesihatan
e: Significant hazards ABC Chemicals: contact with chemicals hazardous to health, fire, manual lifting (heavy materials).

q: Perniagaan ABC Chemicals (M) Sdn. Bhd. dalam Latihan 1 ialah:
e: Exercise 1: Nature of business – supply of chemicals; 230 pekerja (semua warganegara Malaysia).

q: Ringkasan bab menyatakan bahawa dasar OSH perlu dirangka supaya mencerminkan:
e: Summary: formulate the policy to reflect OSH arrangements and organisational goals.

q: Program pelaksanaan dasar OSH menurut ringkasan meliputi semua berikut KECUALI:
e: Summary 4: implement by policy implementation programme – assign responsibilities to all, provide arrangements, monitor, review as necessary.
